Our Story

Part pirate ship.
Part pink ribbon.

The Pink Kraken isn't just another boat at Holden Beach. She's a 22-foot pontoon done up as a pirate ship, painted the way she is on purpose — every charter sails under a pink flag for breast cancer awareness, alongside a crew that wants your family's afternoon to be the story you tell for years.

[Owner's note: swap this paragraph for your own founding story — who The Pink Kraken is sailing for, and why pink.]

The Adventure

What happens once you cast off

Every charter is captained and run the same way, no matter which adventure you pick — it's your private ship for the whole trip.

Captain at the helm

Your pirate captain and crew handle the ship, the stories, and the safety talk — you just sit back.

Treasure hunt

A proper hunt for the young (and young at heart) pirates on board, built into the route.

Intracoastal sightseeing

Cruising the waterway with a real shot at dolphins alongside the boat.

Photos built in

Crew-guided photo moments so nobody misses the shot for chasing it themselves.

Music & pirate atmosphere

A soundtrack, the flag flying, and a crew that's genuinely into the theme.

Cannons & sandbar stops

Cannon fire on the longer trips, plus a sandbar or beach stop when conditions allow.

Our Cause

Why she's painted pink

Every trip aboard The Pink Kraken sails under the same flag she was built for — raising awareness for breast cancer, and giving survivors, fighters, and the families behind them a reason to celebrate on the water.

We're a small crew with a big goal: make this the most talked-about hour of your Holden Beach trip, for a cause worth talking about too.
